2735.title: Fenced diff rows lack semantic backgrounds
2735.rootCauseOneLine: The Markdown stylesheet defines token colors but no rules for the semantic diff row classes emitted by the highlighter.
2735.proposedFix: Add scoped theme-derived backgrounds for the four diff row classes and retain the focused regression test.
2735.caveats: This report tests the locked dependency version and does not test a dependency update.
